indexes.expression: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auth_invites_pending_tenant_email_uidx ON public.auth_invites USING btree (tenant_id, email) WHERE ((status)::text = 'pending'::text)
CREATE INDEX auth_users_fullname_trgm_idx ON public.auth_users USING gin (((profile ->> 'fullName'::text)) gin_trgm_ops) WHERE (profile IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX blocked_ips_active_index ON public.blocked_ips USING btree (ip_address) WHERE (unblocked_at IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_campaign_recipients_provider_message ON public.campaign_recipients USING btree (provider_message_id) WHERE (provider_message_id <> ''::text)
CREATE INDEX idx_dispatch_jobs_tenant_driver ON public.dispatch_jobs USING btree (tenant_id, assigned_driver_id) WHERE (assigned_driver_id <> ''::text)
CREATE INDEX idx_dispatch_jobs_tenant_vehicle ON public.dispatch_jobs USING btree (tenant_id, assigned_vehicle_id) WHERE (assigned_vehicle_id <> ''::text)
CREATE INDEX fleet_devices_verification_deadline_index ON public.fleet_devices USING btree (verification_deadline) WHERE (verification_deadline IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX fleet_waybills_invoice_index ON public.fleet_waybills USING btree (invoice_id) WHERE (invoice_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fleet_waybills_tenant_number_unique ON public.fleet_waybills USING btree (tenant_id, waybill_number) WHERE (waybill_number IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_job_offers_pending_expiry ON public.job_offers USING btree (expires_at) WHERE (status = 'pending'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX organisation_upgrade_requests_one_open ON public.organisation_upgrade_requests USING btree (tenant_id) WHERE ((status)::text = 'pending'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wallet_top_ups_reference_uidx ON public.wallet_top_ups USING btree (reference) WHERE (reference IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_whatsapp_conversations_tenant_last_message_at ON public.whatsapp_conversations USING btree (tenant_id, COALESCE(last_message_at, created_at) DESC)
